title: Expansive solutions and the boundary at infinity for the homogeneous $N$-body problem
summary: We investigate expansive solutions of the $N$-body problem in $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d\ge2$) driven by homogeneous Newtonian potentials of degree $-α$. We establish the existence of half-entire expansive motions with prescribed initial configuration and asymptotic direction for a wide range of homogeneity exponents $α$. Our approach is variational and relies on the minimization of a suitably renormalized Lagrangian action, allowing us to treat in a unified framework the hyperbolic, parabolic, and hyperbolic-parabolic regimes in the sense of Chazy's classification.
